full_judgment:
3. The defendant is contesting the suit by filing written statement, contending, inter alia, that the suit is not maintainable and is also barred by limitation and on the principle of acquiescence, waiver and estopel. The allegations against the defendant made in the plaint have been denied in the written statement. It is stated that on 28.7.87 at night there was stormy weather, heavy rain and gusty wind. The plaintiff's ship being a higger vessel was responsible for such accident causing serious injury to the defendant's vessel. It is denied that the aforesaid accident was caused due to carelessness of the Master and other crews of the defendant's vessel, whereas there was negligence of duty of the Master and crews of the plaintiff’s vessel. The defendant made a general diary with the Officer-in-Charge of Muladi Police Station on 29.7.87, being G.D. entry No. 825 dated 29.7.87 alleging that in violation of Navigation Rules and Regulations, the Master and other crews of the vessel M.V. Turn caused the above accident. The defendant has denied the reason of causing damage as alleged by the plaintiff. As regards sending the letter for joint inquiry, the defendant denied it stating that it is baseless. Such a plea is created for the purpose of the suit. The defendant has not accepted the claim of repairing cost as alleged in the plaint stating that the same is untrue. In a word, the defendant denied its liability altogether for the alleged damage of the vessel M.V. Turn. 

 (ii) Is the suit barred by limitation or under any other law?
